risks.title: SQL injection in order search
risks.description: Search values are concatenated into SQL text.
risks.mitigation: Use bind parameters in the new repository layer; add a security test.

risks.title: Vulnerable, end-of-life libraries in production
risks.description: log4j 1.2 and commons-collections 3.2.1 carry critical CVEs.
risks.mitigation: Patch or isolate now; replace in wave 1.

risks.title: Pricing logic in PL/SQL
risks.description: Prices are computed in PKG_ORDER_PRICING; moving it to Java can change results.
risks.mitigation: Capture current results as golden tests before the rewrite.

risks.title: Database password in a properties file
risks.description: The database password is stored in configuration.

risks.title: Pricing service availability
risks.description: Order detail depends on the external pricing SOAP service.
risks.mitigation: Add timeouts and a circuit breaker.
